{"implementation":"def solve(case):
    threshold = case['payload']['threshold']
    calls = case['payload']['calls']
    accepted_ids = []
    diagnostics = []
    for call in calls:
        call_id = call['call_id']
        loss_without = call['loss_without_call']
        loss_with = call['loss_with_call']
        tokens = call['prediction_tokens']
        parseable = call['parseable']
        gain = loss_without - loss_with
        normalized = gain / max(1, tokens)
        rounded = round(normalized, 6)
        accepted = parseable and (rounded >= threshold)
        if accepted:
            accepted_ids.append(call_id)
        diagnostics.append({'call_id': call_id, 'normalized_gain': rounded, 'accepted': accepted})
    return {'accepted_call_ids': accepted_ids, 'diagnostics': diagnostics}"}
